scope: N180 persisted regression colouring: retain independent marker-shape and opacity choices
request_basis: N180 specifies saved colouring; existing N222 source/tests make hue, shape and opacity fixed roles of one regression plot, not separately documented global preferences.

initial_fixture_result.note: The fixture used plate, which normal CSV reading canonicalises through schema.LEGACY_COLUMN_NAMES to PLATE_KEY. The picker therefore did not offer literal plate. Replaced only that fixture column with ordinary batch; precondition and restore assertions unchanged.

corrected_before.reason: Shape-only, opacity-only with unused shape, and all-three configurations each lost secondary channels after a real JSON workspace round trip.

change.representation: Independent chosen column names or None; retains an unused shape slot without shifting opacity into its role.
change.restore: All three channel choices apply with QSignalBlocker before the existing redraw. Unknown or omitted entries retain their current choices; explicit None selects no encoding.
change.compatibility: Legacy colour_by and selected_key remain intact. Existing no-primary-colour suppression and duplicate-column policy are unchanged.

actual_widget_checks: JSON round trips retain the two/three channel lists and exact combo roles.
Rendered legend entries retain shape and opacity channel labels.
Switching between two real run CSVs restores each run's choices.
Omitted legacy channel fields preserve existing choices.
Explicit None removes both extra encodings and their legend entries.
limits: This is a companion implementation scope, not whole N180 acceptance.
